title: Siegard skill frontmatter
description: Frontmatter contract for a distributable skill at src/claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Every constraint is either taken from Anthropic documentation, cited per field, or a named Siegard addition. Sources, both retrieved 2026-07-29: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills (field inventory and semantics; every field is optional there) and https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/agents-and-tools/agent-skills/best-practices (hard limits on name and description). Custom slash commands were merged into skills, so Siegard has no separate command class. Decision and divergence list: the harness's own documentation. additionalProperties is false because Claude Code silently ignores unknown frontmatter fields — a typo like 'descripton' would otherwise ship as a silent no-op.

name.description: Skill name. Limits from the platform best-practices page: maximum 64 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only, and it cannot contain the reserved words 'anthropic' or 'claude'. Siegard additions: the field is required (Claude Code treats it as an optional display label), and the validator requires it to equal the skill's directory name, because the directory name is what becomes the /command — a name field that disagrees with it ships a label that is not the invocation.

description.description: What the skill does and when to use it — Claude uses this to decide when to load the skill. Limit from the platform best-practices page: non-empty, maximum 1,024 characters. Siegard addition: required. Claude Code marks it only 'recommended', but a distributable skill without a description cannot be discovered, and a malformed frontmatter block degrades to exactly that state silently. Write it in third person, state what the skill does and the triggers for using it, and put the key use case first: Claude Code truncates the combined description and when_to_use text at 1,536 characters in the skill listing.

when_to_use.description: Additional trigger context, such as example requests. Appended to description in the skill listing and counts toward the same 1,536-character truncation.

argument-hint.description: Hint shown during autocomplete to indicate expected arguments, such as '[issue-number]'.

arguments.description: Named positional arguments for $name substitution. Space-separated string or YAML list; names map to argument positions in order.

disable-model-invocation.description: true prevents Claude from loading the skill on its own — only the user can invoke it. Documented for workflows with side effects, such as deploy or commit. Default: false.

user-invocable.description: false hides the skill from the / menu — only Claude can invoke it. Documented for background knowledge that is not a meaningful user action. Default: true.

allowed-tools.description: Tools Claude may use without a permission prompt during the turn that invokes this skill; the grant clears on the next user message. This is a pre-approval, not a restriction — under the least-privilege invariant in CLAUDE.md, list only what the skill's own steps require.

disallowed-tools.description: Tools removed from Claude's pool while the skill is active; clears on the next user message.

model.description: Model while the skill is active, for the rest of the current turn: an alias, a full model ID, or 'inherit'.

effort.description: Effort level while the skill is active. Overrides the session level; available levels depend on the model.

context.description: Runs the skill in a forked subagent context; the skill content becomes the subagent's prompt. Documented as meaningful only for skills with explicit instructions — a guidelines-only skill forked this way returns nothing useful.

agent.description: Subagent type to execute the fork: a built-in agent or a custom agent name. Meaningful only with context: fork, which the dependentSchemas clause enforces. Defaults to general-purpose.

background.description: false makes the invoking turn wait for the forked subagent instead of running it in the background. Only applies with context: fork, which the dependentSchemas clause enforces. Default: true.

hooks.description: Lifecycle hooks scoped to this skill. The hook configuration format is governed by https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks, not by this contract.

paths.description: Glob patterns limiting automatic activation to work on matching files.

shell.description: Shell for !`command` dynamic-context injection in this skill. Default: bash.

agent.description: The docs define agent as 'which subagent type to use when context: fork is set' — without the fork it configures nothing.

background.description: The docs state background 'only applies with context: fork' — without the fork it configures nothing.
